description: Financial analysis of a Romanian company: multi-year revenue trend (YoY, 3/5/10-year CAGR), margins, headcount, solvency and liquidity ratios, a 0–100 health score with its rule-by-rule breakdown, red flags, and peer percentiles within the same CAEN activity and county. Verdict: 'growing', 'stable' or 'distressed'. Use lookup_financials for the raw figures.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

name: lookup_financial_ratios

outputSchema.description: Financial ratios, a health score, peer percentiles and a verdict.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

distress.description: true when the distress signals fire.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

found.description: Whether any filing is on record.

healthScore.description: 0-100 score, band and its rule-by-rule components.

history.description: Years on record, loss years, revenue peak.

peers.description: Percentiles within the same CAEN activity and county.

ratios.description: Margins, equity ratio, debt to equity, liquidity, returns.

revenueTrend.description: Latest revenue, YoY growth, 3/5/10-year CAGR, trend label.

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

years.description: Per fiscal year figures and margins.

title: Financial ratios and health score
